method: Read-only independently recomputed preserved/source hashes, original native wrapper/process observer and raw logs, independent geometry-test source cold-read. No QA engine execution.
verdict: Private Quarter/Bowl/Sunken component physical-specification checks are source-bound and meaningful. No cold-read blocker; this does not close shared-family gameplay, visible profile, loaded-wheel/full mesh contact or cost gates.
observations: Actual new60mm section and12mm up/10mm inward reveal are independently specified and queried in translated/yawed world. Crown expectation is12mm above concrete and20mm behind face tangent;10mm inner reveal follows radius30−offset20.

Actual native top-ray errors in original logs are0.546µm quarter,8.120µm bowl,9.441µm sunken. Test allows2mm for finite curved tessellation; this reported run is substantially tighter. Front-ray positions/normals are asserted but individual measured errors are not retained.

Actual cylinder dimensions and torus mesh/native triangle arrays are checked, along with guide identity/crown and open port steel absence. Old90mm OD/70mm crown quarter is a separate unchanged negative.

Prepared Clyde surface expectation replaces obsolete70mm crown with explicit12mm-up/20mm-behind geometric specification. It does not loosen native contact tolerances or change330 concrete pit-ray expectations.
limits: 24/0 component and Main6/0 are distinct scopes, not an additive full-game regression.

Quarter samples three lateral points and curved constructors five/six azimuths; all curved native/display triangles compare exactly, but normal/winding and gameplay traversal over every triangle are not proven by those sampled rays.
Sunken port absence checks one centre mouth ray; near-end seam/capsule/grind/lip/transfer gameplay and shared halfpipe/spine neighbors remain required.
No real loaded rider or complete continuous line is exercised by this component observer. Normal-speed visible profile and contact proof remain open.

Source corpus covers801 source/doc/export plus observer/wrapper/three old constructors, excludes imported cache. Process observer is sampled, not a proof that no unobserved process ever ran. No timing/M5 claim.
Original rejected parser/inventory epoch01 remains retained separately; it does not contribute gameplay assertions.
